title: A quarterly file imported
assertion: PPRRVU, GPCI, ZIP5, ZIP9 and MUE import only with a window inside the CMS quarter the file states, read from its title lines, its name or its download address; a whole quarter and a correction's two parts of one are accepted; no window, a window leaving the quarter, another year, a start other than a stated effective day, no stated quarter or two stated quarters are refused before anything is written; an undated file's open window and an MPPR window leaving its year are refused; a ZIP5 line of another quarter is refused; a draft of the same name holding another window is never replaced
noFileReason: The files are written to a temporary root by the test; no file.
